name: Seventh Rush
source:
The hero loses his girlfriend and tries to find salvation in hard labor work. At the same time he starts to see attractive girls while at work and in his neighborhood.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公失去了女朋友，试图在艰苦的体力劳动中寻找救赎。与此同时，他在工作中和附近开始看到了有魅力的女孩们。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
